observations: Photo 0 shows a game console with the distinct design of a PlayStation 5 Slim with a disc drive.
Four DualSense-style controllers are present: one black, one white, and two wrapped in clear plastic.
A watermark 'TEEZ GADGETS AND GAMING' is visible across the center of the image.
A small yellow sticker is attached to the black glossy part of the console.
The console and controllers are displayed on a black glass table with a beige upholstered frame.

The photo shows four controllers, creating a discrepancy with the written description.

proof_requests: A video of the console booting up, connecting to PSN, and playing a disc.
Clarification on why the photo shows four controllers while the description says one.
A clear photo of the model number and serial number on the console's base or rear.

response.reason: The discrepancy between the seller's text (one controller) and the photo (four controllers), combined with the presence of a business watermark, makes it unclear if the photo represents the actual item for sale. Verification of the bundle contents and functional state is required.
